subject.title: [Feature]: Expose actual AI Credits consumed per request for GitHub Copilot provider

question: Should OpenClaw treat GitHub Copilot `copilot_usage.total_nano_aiu` as authoritative billed AIC and add a persisted actual-credit field to usage/status surfaces?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the permanent schema and billing-source trust policy affect provider telemetry, persisted usage rows, and user-visible cost reporting.

options.title: Add actual-AIC support after contract proof
options.body: Verify the upstream/live response shape and then add a provider-owned actual-credit field that is clearly distinct from estimated USD.

options.title: Defer pending upstream stability
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers have stronger evidence that GitHub intends this field to be stable billing metadata.

options.title: Limit to documentation for now
options.body: Document that OpenClaw currently reports estimates and quota windows only, without adding billing-grade persistence.

recommendation.title: Add actual-AIC support after contract proof
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream/live response shape and then add a provider-owned actual-credit field that is clearly distinct from estimated USD.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to the Copilot provider and shared usage/schema paths implicated by this feature.
